findings.analysis: The old HX implementation provides hx_equity_closed and independent hx_equity. C is a killed single-cycle reward, F/G are first-hit quantities, U includes regeneration, M counts all events and J=dM/dt. The new differentiable network does not consume financial E.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: Do not rename arbitrary neural readouts or the finite QVI fixture as financial equity, and do not claim the old financial free boundary solves a sensor-task objective.

findings.analysis: Operator readout queries do not advance state. The interval_value/call feature pays a queried endpoint terminal feature each time; summing it over intervals overpays U. network.forward at zero time with observed=True still conditions and writes content. True padding requires observed=False and valid=False.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: Use the continuation-value functions for once-only terminal payoff; retain the distinction between duplicate queries, repeated observations and padding.

findings.analysis: The two first-hit terms combine by logaddexp before exponentiation; nonpositive durations use a safe inactive computation and return log probability minus infinity with zero branch derivative. The discounted root uses a safe expression at zero drift.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: A finite log-risk helper does not change the network risk channel into log-risk; current risk remains an expected interval event count. The finite fixture collection does not certify an entire parameter box.
findings.title: Log F/G preserves rare probabilities and nonpositive-time semantics
findings.validation: Formula and branch inspection; fixture execution reported by numerical owner, not rerun in this review.

findings.analysis: For a uniform source cell of width h, a tiny Brownian step crosses one edge with probability approximately sigma*sqrt(dt)/(h*sqrt(2*pi)). Reconstructing a uniform cell after each step gives effective diffusivity of order sigma*h/(sqrt(2*pi)*sqrt(dt)), which does not approach sigma^2/2 at fixed h. Larger truncation endpoints reduce real tail occupancy but do not automatically fix all-basis or infinitely repeated tiny-gap error.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: Keep failed perpetual stress gates failed. A finite actual-schedule audit is a different, explicitly scoped qualification. Closed quadrature alone cannot remove projection error; silently subdividing gaps is not justified.
findings.title: Repeated short-time QPR projection has a structural small-step error
findings.validation: independent source inspection and mathematical reasoning

findings.analysis: For event index k, the reference uses first passage across x+k*x_reset with deadline T-k*d. Discounted event mass includes exp(-rho*k*d). The refractory occupation formula separates full and recent waits; remaining-phase integration truncates to r<=T, multiplies U/H by exp(-rho*r), and leaves count/active probability undiscounted. These expressions are consistent with the declared process.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: The helper currently constructs default rewards .4/1/.2 and reset=True. Its caller must bind the exact probability, grid, parameters and full durations and prove these settings match the audited model. Order doubling is a sensitivity measurement, not a certified quadrature bound. Errors scaled by max(1,abs(reference)) are absolute errors for probabilities below one, not relative rare-tail accuracy. No future observations are applied.
findings.title: Finite continuation reference handles regenerated counts and remaining age
findings.validation: independent source inspection and mathematical reasoning

findings.analysis: The original tau*log(I/(I-1)) can round to zero at very large I and create infinite counts/NaNs. Current log1p formulas avoid that cancellation and reject event counts above one million. The geometric trace sums all within-interval crossings; local AD treats the integer event count as fixed, which is correct between count changes.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: Do not claim smooth derivatives at grazing events or event-count transitions. This is an analytic event-time reference, not a validated implementation of EventProp.
findings.title: Event-time LIF needs stable periods and a declared count domain
findings.validation: Large-current failure independently identified earlier; all-six-input finite-difference checks reported passed by training owner.

findings.analysis: Dispatch-to-return wall includes process spawn/import and timeout work. RUSAGE_CHILDREN includes reaped failed children. Full-process RSS is measured; per-fit CPU starts later but campaign child CPU covers aggregate process CPU. Diagnostic updates and main updates are separate. No automatic retries are implemented.

Historical preparation/reservations and physical energy remain unknown, not zero. The actual locked plan uses default quality threshold .3, plateau delta .002 and one thread, per training-owner confirmation.

findings.analysis: Independent RNG streams produce identical frontend/head weights per seed and freeze them in the primary regime. Only cores train; their parameter counts, state capacities and output ranges differ. The declared adequacy rule is minimum epochs plus a development plateau and a successful training-only memorization diagnostic, with initial tensors and optimizer restored before the main fit.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: This is a reproducible stopping-rule pass, not a proof of statistical or optimization convergence. Report each core under the fixed interface; keep any jointly trained interface as a separate experiment. CPU FP64 causal attention does not establish optimized-GPU Transformer efficiency. Complete seven-arm scientific comparison remains on HOLD until HCSN numerical admission and the larger confirmation protocol.

findings.analysis: Event-time LIF holds the current observation over the preceding gap. HCSN propagates the prior over the gap and observes at the endpoint. PLIF and S4D remain event-indexed and receive elapsed time through the common input; CfC receives actual durations.
findings.required_interpretation_or_action: These are candidate timing conventions, not direct label leakage for endpoint classification. Freeze and disclose them; a continuous-time physical equivalence or superiority claim requires a separately matched convention.
